All five runs are complete, valid, queried, and high-confidence with no dependency failures; this is a semantic grounding/identity and partial-progress diagnosis, not a transport or schema issue. The partial reference constrains the aggregate but does not establish which object is the mug or supply atomic ground truth; investigate the mismatch rather than forcing partial or weakening the requested criterion.
